manifest.title: Zammad Helpdesk
manifest.author: Zammad Foundation
manifest.description:
Zammad is a web-based, open-source helpdesk/customer support system written in Ruby on Rails.

With Zammad, you can manage customer requests via:

- A modern web interface
- Email integration (incoming/outgoing)
- Social media (Facebook, Twitter, Telegram)
- Chat
- Telephony integrations
- REST API

**Features:**

- Multi-channel: email, web form, chat, phone, social
- Ticket management with SLA tracking
- Knowledge base
- Multi-tenant capable
- Reporting and dashboards
- Extensible via API and integrations
- Fully self-hosted (no SaaS dependency)
- AGPL-3.0 licence

This Cloudron package bundles Zammad with PostgreSQL (via Cloudron addon), Redis (via Cloudron addon), and Memcached (bundled locally). Elasticsearch is disabled by default; full-text search uses PostgreSQL FTS. Outbound email notifications are auto-configured via the Cloudron sendmail addon (SMTP relay).
manifest.tagline: Open-source ticketing and customer support platform
manifest.postInstallMessage:
Zammad is ready. Open the app URL, complete the first-time setup wizard, and create your admin account.

Outbound email notifications are auto-configured to use the Cloudron SMTP relay. No additional setup is required for system notifications.

For inbound email (creating tickets from incoming mail), enable the recvmail addon in the Cloudron app's Location settings.

Optional: connect an external Elasticsearch instance from Zammad admin panel (Settings > Search Index) for full-text search; PostgreSQL FTS is used by default.
